scope: Fixed-claim study only; does not freeze or unlock whole-answer transfer evaluation
decision: Keep both original fixed Flash and full-input MiniCheck unchanged after 60 development pairs; no prompt tuning
pilot_observation: Both 49/60 binary correct; Flash 0/33 false accepts and 16/27 support recall; MiniCheck 3/33 false accepts and 19/27 support recall
calibration: Logistic on clipped raw-score logit; C=1; max_iter=1000; fit and threshold partitions disjoint
threshold: Fixed grid 0..1 step 0.005; empirical risk <=0.05; >=20 accepted pairs from >=10 source groups; maximize acceptance
final_policy: Evaluate unchanged fixed methods once on all 339 eligible official dev pairs; do not inspect outcomes to tune whole-answer methods
ordering_amendment: Independent fixed-task GPU calibration can proceed while whole-answer development is running. Separate freezes protect separate research questions.
